writing implement.englishDescription: A writing implement such as a ball-point pen, marker, etc.

written petition.definitionKo: 억울하거나 딱한 사정을 남에게 알려 도와주기를 간절히 바라는 내용을 쓴 글이나 문서.
written petition.englishDescription: A piece of writing or document, whose content informs someone of one's unfair or pitiful situation, earnestly seeking help.

wrong information.definitionKo: 사건이나 소식을 사실과 다르게 잘못 전하여 알려 줌. 또는 그 사건이나 소식.
wrong information.englishDescription: The act of reporting an incident or news falsely, or the falsely reported incident or news.

years old.englishDescription: A bound noun that serves as a unit for counting years of age.

yeonssaum.definitionKo: 연을 날려 서로 연실을 마주 걸어서 상대방의 연실을 끊는 놀이.
yeonssaum.englishDescription: kite fighting: A game in which kite flyers compete by crossing their kite strings to cut each other.

yoreom.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '요리하면' (a conjugated form of '요리하다' (do this way)).
An abbreviated word for '요러하면' (a conjugated form of '요러하다' (be this way)).
